43187-the-harlequin-opal-a-romance-vol-1.title: A Romance
43187-the-harlequin-opal-a-romance-vol-1.creator: Unknown
43187-the-harlequin-opal-a-romance-vol-1.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Long years have passed since last we met,  And left their marks of teen and fret;  No longer faces plump and smooth,  Proclaim the halcyon days of youth. But haggard looks and tresses white  Betray the ardour of the fight;  The same old friends: we meet once more--  But not the merry boys of yore.

76649-the-autobiography-of-calvin-coolid.title: The Autobiography Of Calvin Coolidge
76649-the-autobiography-of-calvin-coolid.creator: Unknown
76649-the-autobiography-of-calvin-coolid.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In its natural state this territory was all covered with evergreen and hardwood trees. It had large deposits of limestone, occasionally mixed with marble, and some granite. There were sporadic outcroppings of iron ore, and the sands of some of the streams showed considerable traces of gold. The soil was hard and rocky, but when cultivated supported a good growth of vegetation.

arxiv-2004-09027.title: Will the subprocesses ρ ​ ( 770 , 1450 ) 0 → K + ​ K − \rho(770,1450)^{0}\to K^{+}K^{-} contribute large branching fractions for B ± → π ± ​ K + ​ K − B^{\pm}\to\pi^{\pm}K^{+}K^{-} decays?
arxiv-2004-09027.creator: Wen-Fei Wang
arxiv-2004-09027.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Wen-Fei Wang. We analyze the quasi-two-body decays B + → π + ​ ρ ​ ( 770 , 1450 ) 0 → π + ​ K + ​ K − B^{+}\to\pi^{+}\rho(770,1450)^{0}\to\pi^{+}K^{+}K^{-} in the perturbative QCD approach. The results in this work do not support that large branching fractions contributed by the resonances ρ ​ ( 770 , 1450 ) 0 \rho(770,1450)^{0} in the B ± → π ± ​ K + ​ K − B^{\pm}\to\pi^{\pm}K^{+}K^{-} decays.

arxiv-2108-09949.title: One numerical obstruction for rational maps between hypersurfaces Thanks: MS 2020 classification : 14E05, 14M10, 28D20 Thanks: Key words : rational map, hypersurface, entropy
arxiv-2108-09949.creator: Ilya Karzhemanov
arxiv-2108-09949.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ilya Karzhemanov. Given a rational dominant map ϕ : Y ⇢ X \phi:Y\dashrightarrow X between two generic hypersurfaces Y , X ⊂ ℙ n Y,X\subset\mathbb{P}^{n} of dimension ≥ 3 \geq 3 , we prove (under an addition assumption on ϕ \phi ) a “ Noether – Fano type ” inequality m Y ≥ m X m_{Y}\geq m_{X} for certain (effectively computed) numerical invariants of Y Y and X X .

arxiv-2207-05804.title: Characterizing Interface Topology in Multiphase Flows using Skeletons
arxiv-2207-05804.creator: Xianyang Chen, Jiacai Lu, Stéphane Zaleski, Grétar Tryggvason
arxiv-2207-05804.description: Abstract The unsteady motion of a gas-liquid interface, such as during splashing or atomization, often results in complex liquid structures embedded in the ambient fluid. Here we explore the use of skeletonization to identify the minimum amount of information needed to describe their geometry.

arxiv-2208-03377.title: On direct observation of millicharged particles at c c - τ \tau factories and other e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} -colliders
arxiv-2208-03377.creator: Dmitry Gorbunov, Dmitry Kalashnikov, Pavel Pakhlov, Timofey Uglov
arxiv-2208-03377.description: Abstract Hypothetical particles with tiny electric charges (millicharged particles or MCPs) can be produced in electron-positron annihilation if kinematically allowed. Typical searches for them at e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} colliders exploit a signature of a single photon with missing energy carried away by the undetected MCP pair.

arxiv-2211-05737.title: IK-Geo: Unified Robot Inverse Kinematics Using Subproblem Decomposition
arxiv-2211-05737.creator: Alexander J. Elias, John T. Wen
arxiv-2211-05737.description: Abstract This paper presents the open-source robot inverse kinematics (IK) solver IK-Geo, the fastest general IK solver based on published literature. In this unifying approach, IK for any 6-DOF all-revolute (6R) manipulator is decomposed into six canonical geometric subproblems solved by intersecting circles with other geometric objects.

arxiv-2302-08577.title: For Generated Text, Is NLI-Neutral Text the Best Text?
arxiv-2302-08577.creator: Michail Mersinias, Kyle Mahowald
arxiv-2302-08577.description: Abstract We explore incorporating natural language inference (NLI) into the text generative pipeline by using a pre-trained NLI model to assess whether a generated sentence entails, contradicts, or is neutral to the prompt and preceding text. First, we show that the NLI task is predictive of generation errors made by GPT-3.

arxiv-2305-18456.title: Baselines for Identifying Watermarked Large Language Models
arxiv-2305-18456.creator: Leonard Tang, Gavin Uberti, Tom Shlomi
arxiv-2305-18456.description: Abstract We consider the emerging problem of identifying the presence and use of watermarking schemes in widely used, publicly hosted, closed source large language models (LLMs). We introduce a suite of baseline algorithms for identifying watermarks in LLMs that rely on analyzing distributions of output tokens and logits generated by watermarked and unmarked LLMs.

arxiv-2307-03498.title: Comparative Analysis of Kinetic Realizations of Insulin Signaling Corresponding author. Emails: angelyn.lao@dlsu.edu.ph, pnlubenia@upd.edu.ph, eduardo.mendoza@dlsu.edu.ph
arxiv-2307-03498.creator: Patrick Vincent N. Lubenia, Eduardo R. Mendoza, Angelyn R. Lao
arxiv-2307-03498.description: Abstract Several studies have developed dynamical models to understand the underlying mechanisms of insulin signaling, a signaling cascade that leads to the translocation of glucose, the human body’s main source of energy. Fortunately, reaction network analysis allows us to extract properties of dynamical systems without depending on their model parameter values.

arxiv-2310-00899.title: Space-Efficient and Noise-Robust Quantum Factoring
arxiv-2310-00899.creator: Seyoon Ragavan, Vinod Vaikuntanathan
arxiv-2310-00899.description: Abstract We provide two improvements to Regev’s quantum factoring algorithm (Journal of the ACM 2025), addressing its space efficiency and its noise-tolerance. Our first contribution is to improve the quantum space efficiency of Regev’s algorithm while keeping the circuit size the same.

arxiv-2405-19232.title: DiPPeST: Diffusion-based Path Planner for Synthesizing Trajectories Applied on Quadruped Robots
arxiv-2405-19232.creator: Maria Stamatopoulou, Jianwei Liu, Dimitrios Kanoulas
arxiv-2405-19232.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maria Stamatopoulou, Jianwei Liu, Dimitrios Kanoulas. We present DiPPeST, a novel image and goal conditioned diffusion-based trajectory generator for quadrupedal robot path planning. DiPPeST is a zero-shot adaptation of our previously introduced diffusion-based 2D global trajectory generator (DiPPeR). The introduced system incorporates a novel strategy for local real-time path refinements, that is reactive to camera input, without requiring any further training, image processing, or environment interpretation techniques.

arxiv-2405-20690.title: DiffPuter: Empowering Diffusion Models for Missing Data Imputation
arxiv-2405-20690.creator: Hengrui Zhang, Liancheng Fang, Qitian Wu, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2405-20690.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hengrui Zhang, Liancheng Fang, Qitian Wu, Philip S. Yu. Generative models play an important role in missing data imputation in that they aim to learn the joint distribution of full data. However, applying advanced deep generative models (such as Diffusion models) to missing data imputation is challenging due to 1) the inherent incompleteness of the training data and 2) the difficulty in performing conditional inference from unconditional generative models.

arxiv-2409-14420.title: Nonmodal stability analysis of the plane Poiseuille flow in a multilayer porous-fluid channel
arxiv-2409-14420.creator: Supriya Karmakar, Priyanka Shukla
arxiv-2409-14420.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Supriya Karmakar, Priyanka Shukla. The stability of plane Poiseuille flow of a viscous Newtonian fluid in a multilayer channel with anisotropic porous walls is analyzed using the classical modal analysis, the energy method, and the non-modal analysis. The influence of porous wall parameters such as depth ratio (ratio of porous layer thickness to fluid layer thickness) and anisotropic permeability (in terms of mean-permeability and anisotropy parameter) on flow instability are investigated.

arxiv-2501-12081.title: SPM 25: open source neuroimaging analysis software
arxiv-2501-12081.creator: Tim M. Tierney, Nicholas A. Alexander, Nicole Labra Avila, Yaël Balbastre, Gareth Barnes, Yulia Bezsudnova, Mikael Brudfors, Korbinian Eckstein, Guillaume Flandin, Karl Friston, Amirhossein Jafarian, Olivia S. Kowalczyk, Vladimir Litvak, Johan Medrano, Stephanie Mellor, George O’Neill, Thomas Parr,
arxiv-2501-12081.description: Abstract 1 Summary Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) is an integrated set of methods for testing hypotheses about the brain’s structure and function, using data from imaging devices. These methods are implemented in an open source software package, SPM , which has been in continuous development for more than 30 years by an international community of developers.

arxiv-2503-08318.title: Josephson diode effect with Andreev and Majorana bound states
arxiv-2503-08318.creator: Sayan Mondal, Pei-Hao Fu, Jorge Cayao
arxiv-2503-08318.description: Abstract Superconductor-semiconductor hybrids have been shown to be useful for realizing the Josephson diode effect, where nonreciprocity in the supercurrents occurs due to the interplay of the Josephson effect and applied magnetic fields. With the same ingredients, these Josephson junctions can also host Andreev and Majorana bound states, whose interplay with the Josephson diode effect is however not fully understood.

pmc-10709008.title: Rural recreation tourism in the Panxi region of China in the context of ecological welfare
pmc-10709008.creator: Yanhong Wang, Lin Wang, Weiran Zhou, Qianbing Ying
pmc-10709008.description: Urbanisation has improved living, health and welfare standards but degraded the ecological environment. Tourism models are constantly innovating, and the rural health model is attracting attention to rural recreation, and research on eco-welfare performance and tourism efficiency in ethnic minority rural areas is an important foundation for the construction of ecological civilisation and sustainable development in ethnic minority rural areas.

pmc-11712720.title: Polyphenols derived from Sorghum bicolor grains exhibit the ability to alleviate amyloid beta in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-11712720.creator: Rasheed A Abdulraheem, Prashant Bharadwaj, Zhaoyu Li, Ranil Coorey, Stuart Johnson, Ralph N Martins, Warnakulasuriya Mary Ann Dipika Binosha Fernando
pmc-11712720.description: BackgroundAccumulation of amyloid beta 42 (Aβ42) senile plaques is the most critical event leading to Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Currently approved drugs for AD have not been able to effectively modify the disease. This has caused increasing research interests in health beneficial nutritious plant foods as viable alternative therapy to prevent or manage AD.

pmc-12487526.title: Improving the accuracy and precision of disease identification when utilizing EHR data for research: the case for hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12487526.creator: Carrie R. Wong, Yvonne N. Flores, Analissa Avila, Lina Tieu, Catherine M. Crespi, Folasade P. May, Douglas S. Bell, Beth Glenn, Roshan Bastani
pmc-12487526.description: ObjectiveWe assessed the performance of International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes to identify patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in a large academic health system and determined whether employing an algorithm using a combination of ICD codes could deliver higher accuracy and precision than single ICD codes in identifying HCC cases using electronic health record (EHR) data.

pmc-12770617.title: Vegetation carbon use efficiency response to drought in the Manas River Basin of Xinjiang
pmc-12770617.creator: Jingjing Kong, Mei Zan, Zhizhong Chen, Shunfa Yang, Jia Zhou, Lili Zhai
pmc-12770617.description: Carbon Use Efficiency (CUE), quantified as the ratio of net primary production to gross primary production (NPP/GPP), serves as a crucial indicator of ecosystem carbon sequestration capacity. However, understanding of its spatiotemporal dynamics and drought response mechanisms in arid inland basins remains limited.

pmc-13077968.title: Feeding dysfunction in a neonate with interstitial deletion of chromosome 2q24.3-q32.1: a case report
pmc-13077968.creator: Natalia Alvarado-Ramos, Jesús M. Rosario-Rivera, Estefania Rivera-Pedraza, Alondra Melero-Guzmán, Adyanis Centeno, Savannah J. Beltrán, Angel Pacheco Vega
pmc-13077968.description: BackgroundNeonates with multiple congenital anomalies present diagnostic and management challenges, especially when accompanied by multisystemic alterations and feeding difficulties. Chromosomal microarray analysis enables identification of pathogenic variants that explain complex clinical features and guide individualized management.Case presentationWe report a Hispanic female neonate born at 37 weeks with intrauterine growth restriction.

pmc-13391972.title: Association of Serum Adiponectin, Sleep Quality, and Health-promoting Lifestyle with Metabolic Syndrome in Patients with Schizophrenia
pmc-13391972.creator: Smit Ratilal Makwana, Naresh Nebhinani, Pranshu Singh, Dharamveer Yadav, Akshaya B Raj
pmc-13391972.description: Background:Metabolic syndrome (MS) significantly contributes to premature mortality in schizophrenia, which is driven by multiple biological and behavioral factors. While individual risk factors are known, comprehensive studies examining the combined influence of biological markers (adiponectin) and behavioral factors (sleep, lifestyle) in the Indian context are limited.

pmc-13440885.title: The parasitophorous vacuole membrane of Toxoplasma gondii: A custom structural framing with smart interior plumbing for resource allocation
pmc-13440885.creator: Julia D. Romano, Shahbaz M. Khan, Isabelle Coppens
pmc-13440885.description: In essence, the parasitophorous vacuole (PV) of Toxoplasma is a “Do-It-Yourself” renovation project led by the parasite after invasion of a guest house (the host cell) to install itself surreptitiously in a private and custom-built room, reinforced by drywall (the PV membrane).

pmc-13633364.title: Prognostic value of volume-based metabolic parameters of [18F]FDG PET/CT in anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
pmc-13633364.creator: H I Coerts, O P Smit, J F Lin, P van Houten, T P Links, A H Brouwers, C CD van der Rijt, T M van Ginhoven, R T Netea-Maier, M JC van Treijen, M Medici, B de Keizer, S Kruijff, F A Verburg

pmc-13654006.title: Osteochondral lesions of the talus in the pediatric population: A practical narrative review
pmc-13654006.creator: Marco Turati, Simone Daniel Gatti, Monika Thüsing, Matteo Guelfi, Marco Crippa, Jaakko Sinikumpu, Marco Bigoni
pmc-13654006.description: Osteochondral lesions of the talus (OLTs) in children and adolescents are a clinically important cause of persistent ankle pain after trauma and may also be present without a clear inciting event. Because plain radiographs may fail to detect OLTs or may underestimate their severity, modern pediatric pathways rely on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for characterization.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The President, within 10 days after receiving it.
